protocol.question: Do matched linear MC/pairwise readouts expose recoverable preference signal beyond original V, and does all-N improve it?
protocol.GO: Both seeds show >=0.05 test root-mean ranking-accuracy gain over P1 with no success-control regret increase; only finite authorized closed-loop may follow.
protocol.KILL: No consistent two-seed held-out gain: seal this candidate; no second-round IL/RL.
protocol.split: case%5: train 0,1,2; dev 3; test 4, across all model seeds. No dev selection or early stopping.
protocol.label_budget: Identical candidate G set for MC and pairwise; pairwise uses all unordered pairs within root, never additional rollout labels.
protocol.controls: Same linear256->1 initialization from old V, encoder frozen; P2/P3 TTC5, P4 full-N MC and pairwise. Predicted vs actual windows separate.
protocol.label_semantics: q=r_env+.99*(1-terminal)*head(z); target full deployment-policy branch G. P1-native-qpred is a separate raw original score control.
protocol.limitation: No inference of navigation gain, training-continuation causation, or OOD from complete 20-person branch G.

reason: Readout evidence alone does not establish causal navigation improvement; training/deployment continuation needs matched labels.
